description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wall of Deceit, adding {U}.
When Wall of Deceit dies, Yedora triggers, returning Wall of Deceit from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Wall of Deceit by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Wall of Deceit's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
